answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before earning reputation. Random audits compare its work with other accounts; when reviewers confirm copied outputs or coordinated identities, the linked bonds are slashed. A sparrow-sized stake is too small: set the bond above the expected reward from fake reputation. An attacker who creates many sybils must fund each one and risks losing that capital, so scaling the attack becomes costly. The bond might be held in timber or pearl tokens, but its value—not the token’s name—creates the deterrent.
